dataset.caveat: IBM identifies this CSV as sample data for a fictional telecommunications company (cross-sectional snapshot of 7,043 subscribers). Associations and model scores do not establish causality or verified live commercial revenue impacts.

prescriptive_recommendations.target_segment: Month-to-month subscribers in early tenure (1-12 months)
prescriptive_recommendations.descriptive_evidence: Month-to-month accounts span 3,875 customers (55.02% of base) at 42.71% churn (95% CI [41.16%, 44.27%]), accounting for 88.55% of all churn and $120,847.10/mo in historical monthly billing of churned records. The narrowed 1-12 mo subset (n=1,994, 28.31% of base) churns at 51.35% (1,024 churners = 54.79% of all churn).
prescriptive_recommendations.diagnostic_evidence: Contract has the strongest categorical association with Churn (chi2=1184.6, Cramer's V=0.4101, Holm p=9.97e-257), followed by tenure_tier (V=0.3512). Controlling for covariates, Two-year contracts show adjusted OR=0.2602 vs Month-to-month.
prescriptive_recommendations.predictive_evidence: Raw-column test permutation ranks Contract #1 (dROC-AUC=0.0428) and tenure #2 (dROC-AUC=0.0256). Test Tier 1 (p>=0.50, n=275) realizes 67.27% churn.
prescriptive_recommendations.proposed_action: Launch structured first-90-day onboarding check-ins and test step-down annual contract migration incentives (e.g., locked rate or waived upgrade fee) specifically among Model Tier 1 & Tier 2 early-tenure accounts.
prescriptive_recommendations.assumptions_and_caveats: Assumes contract-migration incentives achieve an assumed 15-25% relative churn reduction without eroding net margin; IBM data is cross-sectional and does not test experimental discount elasticity.

prescriptive_recommendations.target_segment: Fiber optic subscribers lacking OnlineSecurity or TechSupport
prescriptive_recommendations.descriptive_evidence: Within broad Fiber optic accounts (n=3,096, 41.89% churn, $114,300.05/mo historical churned billing), the narrowed target cohort lacking OnlineSecurity or TechSupport comprises n=2,722 accounts (38.65% of base) with 45.70% churn (95% CI [43.84%, 47.58%], 1,244 churners = 66.56% of all churn, $108,733.60/mo historical churned billing). Those lacking both add-ons (n=1,765) churn at 55.01% vs 14.17% for Fiber users with both (n=374).
prescriptive_recommendations.diagnostic_evidence: OnlineSecurity (V=0.3474), TechSupport (V=0.3429), and InternetService (V=0.3225) rank 3rd-5th in association strength. Even after controlling for tenure and contract, Fiber optic retains adjusted OR=2.5646, whereas OnlineSecurity_Yes (OR=0.6913) and TechSupport_Yes (OR=0.7099) remain protective.
prescriptive_recommendations.predictive_evidence: InternetService ranks #3 (dROC-AUC=0.0162), OnlineSecurity ranks #5, and TechSupport ranks #6 in held-out Random Forest permutation importance.
prescriptive_recommendations.proposed_action: Audit Fiber optic service reliability/price perception and pilot bundled OnlineSecurity + priority TechSupport packages at no extra promotional cost for 3-6 months on Tier 1/2 Fiber accounts lacking both add-ons.
prescriptive_recommendations.assumptions_and_caveats: Assumes lack of add-ons reflects unaddressed perceived value rather than pure unmeasured customer stickiness bias (existing add-on holders may reflect self-selected loyal subscribers rather than causal add-on protection).

prescriptive_recommendations.descriptive_evidence: Electronic check accounts (n=2,365, 33.58% of base) churn at 45.29% (95% CI [43.29%, 47.30%], $84,288.75/mo historical churned billing) vs 15.24% for Credit card automatic payers — accounting for 57.30% of all churn.
prescriptive_recommendations.diagnostic_evidence: PaymentMethod shows strong bivariate dependence (chi2=648.1, V=0.3034, Holm p=4.42e-139). After controlling for contract, tenure, and charges, Electronic check retains an elevated adjusted OR=1.3601.
prescriptive_recommendations.predictive_evidence: PaymentMethod ranks #7 (dROC-AUC=0.0022) in held-out test importance and helps separate Tier 2 Elevated Risk accounts (41.96% actual churn) from Tier 3 Low Risk.
prescriptive_recommendations.proposed_action: Promote streamlined enrollment into automatic credit card or bank transfer autopay with small one-time billing credits paired with clear paperless payment reminders.
prescriptive_recommendations.assumptions_and_caveats: Assumes payment-method switching reduces accidental/bill-shock churn rather than merely selecting already loyal customers.

prescriptive_recommendations.target_segment: Hold-out accounts exceeding CV F1-optimal cutoff (p >= 0.33)
prescriptive_recommendations.descriptive_evidence: Baseline full-sample churn is 26.54% (n=1,869 / 7,043) with $139,130.85/mo historical billing across churned records (30.50% of total monthly billing); untargeted outreach wastes 73.46% of contacts on non-churners.
prescriptive_recommendations.diagnostic_evidence: Multivariate churn risk spans Contract (V=0.4101), tenure_tier (V=0.3512), OnlineSecurity (V=0.3474), and PaymentMethod (V=0.3034); a calibrated probability threshold integrates all risk factors simultaneously without arbitrary single-variable exclusions.
prescriptive_recommendations.predictive_evidence: Random Forest (Test ROC-AUC=0.8440, PR-AUC=0.6513, Brier=0.1361) at CV F1-optimal cutoff tau=0.33 flags n=499/1,409 (35.42%) test accounts (Tier 1 p>=0.50: n=275, 67.27% realized churn; Tier 2 0.33<=p<0.50: n=224, 41.96% churn), capturing 74.60% of test churners (279/374) at 55.91% precision (F1=0.6392) vs Tier 3 Low Risk (10.44% churn).
prescriptive_recommendations.proposed_action: Use probability-threshold triage when outreach budget scales to ~35% of base: route Tier 1 (p>=0.50) to high-touch agent outreach, Tier 2 (0.33<=p<0.50) to automated digital offers, and exclude Tier 3 (p<0.33).
prescriptive_recommendations.assumptions_and_caveats: Distinct from a fixed Top-30% budget queue (see REC-5). Model trained on fictional cross-sectional snapshot; live deployment requires A/B uplift validation and periodic calibration monitoring.

prescriptive_recommendations.target_segment: Top 30% capacity-ranked risk queue (empirical test cutoff p >= 0.3918)
prescriptive_recommendations.descriptive_evidence: In the full snapshot, churned records carry $139,130.85/mo in historical monthly charges ($64.76 avg across all vs $74.44 among churned), making volume-capped prioritization critical when retention team capacity is strictly budgeted below the 35.42% F1-threshold share.
prescriptive_recommendations.diagnostic_evidence: High-risk concentration within short-tenure Fiber and Month-to-month segments creates steep diminishing marginal risk in the bottom 70% of accounts, supporting ranked queue ordering by calibrated churn probability.
prescriptive_recommendations.predictive_evidence: Ranking the sealed 1,409 test accounts by Random Forest probability selects n=423 (30.02% capacity, min predicted p=0.3918), capturing 246/374 (65.78%) test churners at 58.16% precision (2.19x lift over random) and covering $18,907.85/mo (69.48% of the $27,214.90/mo historical churned billing in test).
prescriptive_recommendations.proposed_action: When outreach team capacity is fixed at <=30% of accounts (~2,113 seats if scaled proportionally across a 7,043-customer base as an illustrative benchmark), rank customers descending by predicted probability and contact the top-30% queue rather than using the looser 0.33 cutoff.
prescriptive_recommendations.assumptions_and_caveats: Observed lift (2.19x) is measured strictly on n=423/1,409 held-out test records; illustrative 6-mo net financial scenarios ($15-$25 cost, 10%-30% save rate) depend on untested causal uplift assumptions.
